limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: A state between the living world and the world of the dead!

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: But why am I here? Why have I not been brought to the afterlife?

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: It seems that although you're dead physically, your soul has enough willpower to move forward.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: Possibly, but that's not always the case.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: Try going through that portal behind you.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: If your willpower is strong enough, you might be able to return to the living world.

limbo_intro_2.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_2.text: Yeah... about that.. is that deal still on the table?

limbo_intro_2.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_2.text: I don't know... I don't really feel like making deals with people right now...

limbo_intro_2.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_2.text: Especially not those with weird curses...

limbo_intro_2.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_2.text: And who also wear super ugly knight's armo-

limbo_intro_2.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_2.text: ALRIGHT ALRIGHT WE GET IT, I WAS WRONG!

limbo_intro_2.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_2.text: I'll collect those shard things for you, so will you please resurrect me and lend me your strength?

limbo_intro_2.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_2.text: You've got yourself a deal! Pleasure doin' business with ya!

limbo_intro_2.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_2.text: I'll open a portal for you, enter it and you'll be back in your very own cursed body!

ghost_greeting.speaker: GHOST
ghost_greeting.text: Back again, huh? Show me what you've got!

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: Lirah first, hero. I only haggle with heavy pockets.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: No Lirah, no sale. Even stone has standards.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: That price is carved in rock. Bring Lirah.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: I smell want, but I do not hear Lirah.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: You cannot buy with hope. I tried. Look at me.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: My eyes are gold nuggets for a reason. They do not blink for charity.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: Bring a purse, not a prayer.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: If your purse is empty, your hands stay empty too.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: You touch, you pay. You do neither.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: Hear that tapping? That is my flesh hand counting what you lack.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: Come back when your purse clinks louder than your armor.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: My stone face cracks, but my prices do not.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: I trade in Lirah. You currently have none.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: Spend less dying, earn more Lirah.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: Your curse is tragic. Your budget is worse.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: If pity were currency, you'd be rich. Sadly for you, it isn't.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: I have seen kings beg. They paid first.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: You can take a look for free. Touching costs extra.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: The earth let me keep my Lirah. It did not grant free samples.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: My guy, that item has a price, you broke af. Go earn some Lirah you lazy ass.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: Your ambition is expensive. Try being poorer elsewhere.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: No Lirah? Then all you bought today is a lesson.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: Bring me enough Lirah, and I might even smile less terribly.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: The nuggets in my eyes only see payment.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: My arm twitches when it senses wealth. It has been very calm around you.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: You are one Lirah short of dignity. Maybe more.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: If you keep staring at it, the price does not change.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: Avarus sells miracles. Avarus does not fund them.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: Your greed is impressive. Your finances are not.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: I learned this the hard way: wanting and paying are different verbs.

Avarus_no_coins.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_no_coins.text: Come back with Lirah, and I might call you customer instead of tourist.

Avarus_intro.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_intro.text: Welcome to my stall, traveler. Avarus the Gilded, at your service.

Avarus_intro.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_intro.text: A title earned over a long and expensive life.

Avarus_intro.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_intro.text: Mostly. Efficient, durable, and rarely interrupted by sleep.

Avarus_intro.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_intro.text: Stubborn flesh. Useful for counting and pointing at merchandise.

Avarus_intro.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_intro.text: A practical reminder to focus on value.

Avarus_intro.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_intro.text: Now then, browse. If anything calls your name, bring Lirah.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Take your time. Stone has all of it.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Hear that tapping? That is my hand pricing your hesitation.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: The dungeon is loud. Lirah is louder.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: I do not sleep. I inventory.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Lirah taught me permanence. Regret taught me interest rates.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Do not mind the moss. It is part of the uniform.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Every crack in me has a receipt.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Your boots track dust. Your purse tracks fate.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: I can smell copper from here. Sadly, I prefer Lirah.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: I have sold to heroes, cowards, and worse. Lirah spends the same.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: The living haggle. The dead pay full price.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: My smile is carved in. My generosity is not.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Look all you like. Looking is still free.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: A good customer leaves lighter than they arrived.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: If my arm points at an item, it usually means profit.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Lirah eyes see through excuses.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Sometimes I miss blinking. Mostly I miss compound interest.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: I was a warning once. Now I am a business model.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Do not confuse stillness with kindness.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: The best bargains are the ones you survive.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: I keep my promises and my prices equally sharp.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: A cracked statue can still run a cleaner shop than most kings.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: If fate were fair, I would be flesh. If trade were fair, I would be poor.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: I sell tools, not luck. Bring your own luck.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Moss in the joints, Lirah in the gaze, profit in the ledger.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: The portal out is free. Everything else is not.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: I once chased treasure through a cave-in. Now treasure comes to me.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: If an item whispers your name, it is probably expensive.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: My fingers drum when the room goes quiet. Business should never be quiet.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Heroes collect scars. I collect payment.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Try not to bleed on the merchandise.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: A curse can break a body. Debt can break a dynasty.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Do not worry about my face. It has looked this smug for centuries.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Spend wisely. Come back richer. Repeat until immortal.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: I stand still so your choices can move.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Careful what you covet. The earth is listening.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: You are not my first doomed customer. Just my current one.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: If you hear pebbles shifting, that is just my ego.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: Every item here has a story. Most end in screaming.

Avarus_idle.speaker: AVARUS
Avarus_idle.text: My shelves are honest. They tell you exactly what you can afford.
